Having worked in Intelligence for a number of years let me tell how a document is marked. Let's say a document contains top secret information along with other information that is still classified but not top secret. The beginning and ending of the paragraph or even a sentence is marked with (TS), (S), or (C), depending on the level of the classification of the information in that paragraph or sentence. To say the Hillary didn't know that information she received was classified is plain bullshit. Oh by the way her dodge is that she never got a document that was marked CLASSIFIED. That is certainly true. There is no such marking of CLASSIFIED on any sensitive document with in the U.S. Government. All documents that are classified are marked TOP SECRET, or SECRET, or CONFIDENTIAL. in big bold letters at the top and bottom of the page depending on the classification level of he information on that page. I have seen a TOP SECRET document that had over 100 pages, in which the majority of the pages were not marked or marked CONFIDENTIAL or SECRET depending on the information contained on that page. There was only three pages in the whole 100 page document that are marked TOP SECRET. I got permission to remove the TOP SECRET PAGES from the document so I could down grade it to SECRET and do away with the special handling log that TOP SECRET requires.

Each person who even touches a TOP SECRET document must sign for it when it goes into his possession and the receipt of acceptance is sent to the security officer who is charged with storage of that document. There is a continuous paper trail for all TOP SECRET documents that annotate who, when, where, the purpose, and the time of possession of the document. I have signed for many TOP SECRET Documents not even knowing what was in them because I was a Courier of that document.

As a side light the Certified mail of the U.S. Post Office is authorized to handle classified documents up to and including SECRET documents.
